notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Godsire.
Godsire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating an 8/8 Beast creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Beast token.
The Beast dies, triggering Godsire, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
